pick.headline: Kohl's Christian Democrats win the West German election
pick.summary: In the West German federal election of March 6, 1983, Chancellor Helmut Kohl's CDU/CSU won a decisive victory, and the Greens entered the Bundestag for the first time.
pick.significance: The result was read as a mandate for stationing U.S. Pershing II and cruise missiles in West Germany that autumn, which Moscow and the peace movement had campaigned to stop. Eastern European media had backed the Social Democrats' more skeptical line.
pick.fbis: The East Europe report of March 7, 1983, listed the election only in its contents: a Czechoslovak item on the significance of the CDU/CSU victory and an East German one headed 'Major Victory' for CDU/CSU in FRG Elections.
